resources.string: One tap tests text and binary secrets in both embedding modes, through a real PNG saved to disk and loaded again.
Four round trips. Zero setup. Fully offline.
Generated plasma cover used for the PNG round-trip tests
Kinetic Vault test — नमस्ते 🌌 — Your hand is the key.
All four PNG round trips passed in %1$d ms. Cover generation: %2$d ms.
%1$s · PASS · %2$d ms Forge %3$d · Save %4$d · Reload %5$d · Unlock %6$d ms PSNR %7$.2f dB · Changed %8$.2f%% PNG SHA-256: %9$s…
Not enough free memory. Close other apps and run the test again.
The image or storage check failed. Free some storage, then run again.
The cryptographic check failed. Run again; if it repeats, record your Android version.
A verification check failed. Run again and record the test stage if it repeats.
This temporary screen uses public test data. It does not enroll gestures or store real secrets. Test PNGs are removed after each run.
Gesture pad. Choose Left, Right, Forward, Back, Snap or Flat using the accessibility actions. With a keyboard, use arrow keys and press Enter.
Gesture pad, %1$s selected. Press Enter to add this move. Six gesture actions are also available.
Up to %1$.2f gesture bits. Add %2$d more moves to reach the minimum. Use a strong passphrase for protection.
Low gesture strength: at most %1$.2f bits if moves are uniformly random. Human choices may be weaker. Add a strong passphrase.
Gesture contribution: at most %1$.2f bits; human choices may be weaker. Keep a strong, unique passphrase. Its strength is not estimated here.
Motion sensing is unavailable. Use the Gesture Pad to enter the same moves.
Using accelerometer-only motion sensing. If moves are difficult to repeat, use the Gesture Pad.
Add more moves: a gesture needs 4 to 8 moves. Then choose Done.
The two gestures did not match. Clear both attempts and perform the same moves twice.
Coming soon. This tile will be available in a later step.
Motion orb, %1$d of %2$d dial segments locked
Choose the image that will carry your encrypted secret. A generated cover works entirely offline.
Start with a photo from your device, or Generate a cover for an offline vault.
Choose another image or generate a cover to continue.
No photo was captured. Try the camera again, choose an image, or generate a cover.
The camera could not open. Choose an image from your device or generate a cover.
The document picker is unavailable. Try again after enabling a document provider; for a cover, you can also use Generate.
Add text or one file. Capacity includes the encrypted envelope and authentication tag.
Choose a file to encrypt, or switch to Text to type a secret.
File selected. Its contents and filename will be encrypted.
Ghost scatters the hidden bits. AES-GCM provides encryption; Ghost does not make vaults undetectable.
Gestures alone are easy to guess offline. Use a strong passphrase and remember it exactly, including spaces and capitalization.
Enter a passphrase, or turn off the passphrase option to continue.
Enter text or choose a file to measure capacity.
Fits: %1$d of %2$d bytes used, including encryption overhead.
Too large: %1$d bytes needed; %2$d available. Use a smaller secret, enable compression, or go Back and choose a larger cover.
Preparing the exact secret for enrollment…

Perform 4–8 moves twice. Lower an edge for Left or Right; lower the top for Forward, raise it for Back. Return near level between tilts. Snap downward briefly while face-up; hold flat for half a second for Flat. Choose Done, or remain still for 1.5 seconds after at least four moves. A flat hold is itself a move.
Use the Gesture Pad instead of motion
Ready. Tap Begin, then enter your moves. On the pad, choose Done after the last move.
Recording 1 of 2. Each locked move lights a dial segment.
Recording 2 of 2. Repeat the exact same moves.
First recording complete. Tap Record again and repeat it.
Both recordings match. Your gesture is ready for this vault.
Keep this screen open while your secret is encrypted and embedded. A percentage appears only when the engine reports measurable work.
Stop this attempt and return to the secret step? Re-enter your secret and enroll again to retry.
Forging cancelled. Re-enter the secret and enroll again to retry.
The screen was paused. Enter your secret and passphrase again, then repeat enrollment.
The flow restarted. Choose a cover to begin again; secrets and credentials are not restored.
Not enough memory. Close other apps, choose a smaller image or secret, and try again.
This operation could not finish. Re-select readable inputs, use a smaller secret or shorter filename, and make sure storage has free space. Then try again.
Before and after cover comparison; adjust the slider below to move the dividing line
The preview is for display only. Saving and sharing use the original forged PNG bytes. Keep the gesture and passphrase: they cannot be recovered for you.
PNG saved. Keep the file unchanged so it can be unlocked later.
Could not save or prepare the PNG. Free some storage or choose another destination, then try Save or Share again.
In the receiving app, choose Document or File and keep the PNG unchanged. Sending it as a photo may resize or recompress it and destroy the hidden vault.
No suitable sharing app opened. Save the PNG, then attach it as a document or file from another app.
Choose the original vault image, then repeat its 4–8 moves once. Keep the image unchanged; resized or recompressed copies may not unlock.
Reading the original image and vault header…
No Kinetic Vault signature was found in this image. Choose the original PNG that was saved when the vault was created.
This image could not be read as a supported vault. Choose a readable original PNG, or ask the sender to send it as a document/file.
Tap Record, then repeat the original gesture once. Return near level between tilts. Choose Done after 4–8 moves.
Recording. Repeat the original moves, then choose Done.
Gesture recorded. Enter the passphrase if requested, then Unlock.
Enter the original passphrase, including its exact spaces and capitalization.
Vault unlocked. Read your secret below or choose Export options.
Could not unlock. The credentials may not match, or the image may have been changed or damaged. Record the original gesture again, re-enter the passphrase if requested, or choose the untouched PNG.
Vault locked. Choose an image or record the gesture again to continue.
Saving creates an unencrypted file at your chosen destination. Opening gives another app access to a temporary decrypted copy.
The receiving app can read and retain this decrypted file. A temporary copy will be removed when you return to Reveal. Continue only if you trust that app.
Decrypted file saved. It is no longer protected by the vault.
Could not export the file. Unlock again if needed, free some storage, and choose Save with another destination.
No suitable app could open this file. Use Save, then open it with an app that supports its file type.
Cannot calculate this result. Tap C to clear and try again.
Calculator code (6–12 digits; blank keeps current code)
Enter a 6–12 digit code before enabling disguise mode.
Nerd Mode: show live motion details

Choose a memorable 6–12 digit code, then Save settings. On the calculator, enter those digits and press = to open Home. Blank keeps an existing code; a new code replaces it. There is no code recovery. This disguises the launch screen only; the app icon and shared-image entry remain visible. Nerd Mode displays gesture tokens while recording and protects Hide and Reveal from screenshots.
NERD MODE · Ready\nStart a recording to see live sensors and detected tokens.
NERD MODE · Gesture Pad\nRaw sensors and fused angles are inactive in pad mode.

%4$s
Pitch %5$.1f° · Roll %6$.1f°
α = %7$.2f; predicted = wrap(θ + ω × Δt)
θ = wrap(predicted + (1 − α) × wrap(θacc − predicted))
ω uses gyro rates transformed to pitch/roll.
Save PNG to a chosen folder
Export the original encrypted PNG. Share it as a Document/File so other apps keep its pixels unchanged.
The image picker could not open. Enable a document provider, then choose the vault image again.
Export local event IDs, vault IDs, event types and timestamps as a CSV file. Choose where to save it.
The image picker is unavailable. Enable a document provider and try Open image again, or use Take picture.
This vault has reached its local expiry. Open Vault, change or clear its expiry, then choose the image again to unlock. This policy uses the device clock and does not erase copies.
Your matched moves appear one at a time. Keep the screen private; this preview clears when dismissed or paused. Snap and Flat are named below the title.
Display only · Preview LSBs stripped · 16 × 16 binned density map
Measured source statistics · No decrypted content or credentials · Not an unlockable vault

This sheet reveals the cover image, coarse change locations and image statistics. Share only if that cover is safe to disclose. It is a display image, not a vault or cryptographic proof. Send the PNG as Document/File to keep the sheet clear.
